answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 2209 Country: India Title: I know and love a woman who has a married son. i want to marry her but she afraid of her son and daughter in law. can we marry without telling anyone or kindly suggest some procedure. Question: I know and love a woman who has a married son. i want to marry her but she afraid of her son and daughter in law. can we marry without telling anyone or kindly suggest some procedure. Answer ID: 2209 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 538/538=L) If she is not in nikah of any man presently then you can marry him in the presence two witnesses. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
